items.title: Does Nucor’s (NUE) Indiana Expansion Offset Tariff Uncertainty in Its North American Strategy?
items.summary: Nucor Corporation recently invested US$59,000,000 to expand its Vulcraft Indiana facility to produce steel grating products, adding 20 full-time jobs and building on a series of Indiana manufacturing and infrastructure projects that have created about 300 roles across the state. At the same time, US-Canada talks to reduce steel and aluminum tariffs have raised questions about how increased Canadian import competition could affect Nucor’s position in the North American steel market. items.title: Berkshire ups Alphabet stake under Greg Abel, making it a top-3 holding
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B), under new CEO Greg Abel, increased its Alphabet position, making the Google parent its third-largest U.S.-listed equity holding by market value, behind Apple (AAPL) and American Express (AXP). According to a new filing, Berkshire held roughly 106 million Alphabet shares, valued at $37.9 billion, as of the end of June. Recent reporting confirms Berkshire invested about $10 billion in Alphabet during the second quarter.
